# Plug Launches GenEco™ Scale, an Integrated Electrolyzer Plant Offering with Arcadia eFuels’ 280 MW Project ARC as First Customer


November 17, 2026


Plug announced the commercial launch of GenEco™ Scale, a new integrated electrolyzer plant offering for utility-scale hydrogen production, with Arcadia eFuels as its first customer for the 280-megawatt (MW) hydrogen plant at Project ARC in Texas.


Read the full press release[here](https://www.ir.plugpower.com/press-releases/news-details/2026/Plug-Launches-GenEco-Scale-an-Integrated-Electrolyzer-Plant-Offering-with-Arcadia-eFuels-280-MW-Project-ARC-as-First-Customer/default.aspx)
